meta.defaultTitle: Grey & Ductile Iron Castings from India | Asian Technocast
meta.defaultDescription: Grey and ductile iron castings, machined in-house and exported from Rajkot, India. Motor frames, end shields, pump casings and gearbox housings to ASTM A48 / A536.
